scenes.headline: Twenty-five years of love
scenes.subline: A night of music, memories, and warmth

paragraphs: From Ooty to this beautiful chapter, our parents have built a home filled with laughter and grace.
We invite you to celebrate their journey with a classic evening of old Bollywood favourites.

scenes.message: We hope you will join us for a memorable evening.
